terra.problem: The passage addresses people who enter through those gates; it does not say everyone coming to worship must pass through that particular gate.
The passage does not say everybody coming in could hear Jeremiah.
The treasury joke does not make sense: why would someone have to be counting to receive a message there?
The passage does not say nobody would hear a message in a storeroom or that all the people of Judah came through the gate.
“The card has it right” refers to the lesson card rather than staying in Papa Dorin's world.
“Where they stand on Sunday” introduces a day of worship the passage does not mention and applies it to the people being addressed.
God poses a question about coming to His house and saying they can continue. The explanation states as fact that they then went right back to the acts.
God asks whether they will say this; “They're planning to keep going” presents the proposed speech as a stated fact about their plans.
“They're saying” presents the words in God's question as something the people are stated to have said.
The passage does not say people hide in the house after doing damage. That adds a sequence to the picture of a den of robbers.
The passage asks whether the house has become a den of robbers in their sight; it does not state that robbers hide there.
